newsitem.title: USA: Secret Service agent convicted of sex with minor.
newsitem.headline: Secret Service agent convicted of sex with minor.

text.p: A Secret Service agent who had been assigned to guard former President Ronald Reagan was convicted Friday on sex and drug charges involving a minor.
California Superior Court Judge William Pounders set sentencing for Sept. 18. and ordered Timothy O'Brien, 38, held in custody.
O'Brien, who had guarded the Reagan home in the exclusive Bel-Air section of Los Angeles, was convicted of unlawful sexual intercourse with the 16-year-old daughter of a friend.
The jury, which deliberated for a week, also found him guilty of oral copulation with a minor and drug possession during the course of his affair with the girl last year.
However, the jury acquitted O'Brien of battery and failed to reach a verdict on three other counts, including giving methamphetamine to a minor.
